requirements.requirement: The system must return clinical trial results from the evaluate_care_facade that include a 'phase' field for each trial.
The system must include a 'phase_score' field alongside the 'phase' field in each clinical trial object in the API response.
The system must ensure the 'phase_score' value is a numeric type in the API response.
The system must ensure that for a given trial, the 'phase_score' corresponds to the deterministic mapping defined in the phase scoring logic.
The system must propagate both 'phase' and 'phase_score' fields end-to-end from the domain service through the evaluate_care_facade without omission.
The system must return at least one clinical trial result containing both 'phase' and 'phase_score' when valid upstream data is available.
The system must preserve the original 'phase' string value from the ClinicalTrials.gov response without transformation beyond schema compliance.
The system must include 'phase_score' for all trials where 'phase' is one of the allowed values (I, II, III, IV, N/A).
The system must assign a valid default or null 'phase_score' when the 'phase' field is missing or empty in upstream data.
The system must not throw an error at the facade layer when encountering a trial with an unexpected or unsupported 'phase' value.
The system must return a structurally valid API response even if none of the trials include 'phase' data.
The system must ensure the API response schema matches the defined Pydantic model including both 'phase' and 'phase_score' fields.
The system must validate that 'phase_score' values fall within the normalized scoring range defined by the phase scoring logic.
The system must include 'phase' and 'phase_score' fields in every trial object in the response array when integration is successful.
